policy: Exact CRC32 and byte size. European/Australian SMS releases without USA, World or Japan get PAL preference; shared Europe/Brazil/Korea releases prefer PAL, not proof that every cartridge requires PAL. Manual region overrides always win. Japanese hardware exceptions and non-SMS systems retain existing behavior. Unknown/modified/ambiguous ROMs retain current detection. No filenames or online runtime lookup.

review.runtime_cost: One binary search of at most eight comparisons at region detection; 1656 bytes of constant table data. Reuses the CRC already computed by the core. No per-frame work or runtime I/O.
review.legacy_quick_states: Legacy quick-state/native-state formats do not store the console region or master clock. They continue to load under the current region. For an old NTSC quick state of a ROM now detected as PAL, select USA/60 Hz before loading if needed. Existing input recordings with frameRate metadata are handled separately.
